### ✅ Yes, **Qwen offers a free tier** for its API!
- **Free quota**: Developers can get a certain amount of free tokens (e.g., for testing or small projects) each month via the **Tongyi Lab** platform.
- **Limitations**: The free tier has usage limits (e.g., requests per minute, total tokens per month). For heavy usage, paid plans are available.
- **How to access**:  
  1️⃣ Visit [Qwen's official website](https://www.aliyun.com/product/tongyi) or [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/).  
  2️⃣ Sign up for a Tongyi Lab account.  
  3️⃣ Check the "Free Quota" section for details.

---

### If you meant **another service/platform** (e.g., Twitter, Google Maps, etc.):
Let me know the **name of the service**, and I’ll tell you if it has a free API! 😊
